Web FAQs:
Useful to Know

Are the light bulbs included?
No these have to be bought separately, this allows you the opportunity to choose the colour temperature 2700k for a warm inviting feel, most people use this in the lounge or bedroom or 4000k for a more crisp white, most people use this in the kitchen or study but it's a personal preference. We have a range of highly efficient LED filament lamps, most are dimmable when using an LED compatible dimmer. Take a look at our LED Lamps for the full range.

Is the height of this ceiling light adjustable?
Yes this ceiling light is adjustable on installation

My room has low ceilings is this light suitable?
Yes this light fitting is adjustable on installation to a minimum height of 35cm and is generally suitable for ceiling heights of 2.4m or greater, but please check the measurements in your exact room before purchase, we recommend the light hangs no lower than the door frame.

I have an older house, there is no earth cable where I want to fit my light, can I use this light?
Yes this product is double insulated and is designed to be safe to use where there is no earth cable. It can still be used where an earth cable is present. Your electrician should ensure that earth continuity is maintained in the rest of the wiring loop.
